scope: Sampling frame of the historical pilot: public repositories with a permissive license, English documentation, and a release that an independent registry or release record dates on or before the boundary. Selection looked at license, ecosystem diversity, and history availability, never at the text. Tags and dates are claims that the acquisition script verifies at run time; an entry whose record cannot be corroborated stays vcs_only, and an entry dated after the boundary is skipped.
